description: This file defines the 'Pool' class, a schedulable entity in Apache Spark's scheduler, managing collections of task sets or sub-pools with scheduling algorithms and task management functionalities.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: A schedulable entity representing a collection of pools or task set managers with scheduling capabilities.

methods.name: isSchedulable
methods.description: Indicates that the Pool is always schedulable.

methods.name: addSchedulable
methods.description: Adds a schedulable entity (task set or sub-pool) to this pool.

methods.name: removeSchedulable
methods.description: Removes a schedulable entity from this pool.

methods.name: getSchedulableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a schedulable entity by its name.

methods.name: executorLost
methods.description: Handles the event of an executor being lost.

methods.name: executorDecommission
methods.description: Handles the decommissioning of an executor.

methods.name: checkSpeculatableTasks
methods.description: Checks if there are tasks eligible for speculation.

methods.name: getSortedTaskSetQueue
methods.description: Returns a sorted queue of task sets based on the scheduling algorithm.

methods.name: increaseRunningTasks
methods.description: Increments the count of running tasks.

methods.name: decreaseRunningTasks
methods.description: Decrements the count of running tasks.
